summary: Circular steel flywheel disk, 60 mm diameter and about 6 mm thick (thickness estimated from the 115 g weight). It has a central bore, four pocketed screw holes around the bore, and four counterbored mounting holes near the rim at the diagonals.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front flat face with the outer bolt circle and the counterbores
Rear flat face, which sits against the traction wheel when attached

notes: Only the 60 mm diameter is given. Thickness is estimated from 115 g of steel (density about 7.85 g/cm³) minus the cutouts, and agrees with the stated 551 g·cm² MOI. The bore diameter, hole diameters and hole positions are rough estimates from the renders. The center bore has a keyed or notched profile for the hub that is not modeled here. The four inner holes sit in hex-shaped pockets, and the outer holes are counterbored. Counterbore depths are not stated.
